name: age
description: Applicant age in completed years at application; age at maturity = age + tenure/12

name: citizenship
description: Indian resident citizen required by every lender in the matrix

name: employer_category
description: Employer class; lenders accept or price by it
used_by_rules: employer_types_accepted; fee waivers (SBI/Indian Bank/Union/PNB); Union SRLGE and PNB rate tables

name: net_monthly_income
description: Net take-home salary credited to bank

name: gross_monthly_income
description: Gross salary before deductions; PNB and Indian Bank multiples use gross (if missing the model assumes gross = net / 0.8 and flags it)

name: cibil_score
used_by_rules: min_cibil_score; rate band (PNB and Union published tables; other lenders use the band template)

name: existing_emi_total
description: Sum of EMIs and obligations on existing loans
used_by_rules: foir_cap; Axis tiered obligation rule; Kotak free-income multiple (credit-card dues are added on top)

name: credit_card_outstanding
description: Total revolving balance on credit cards; the model counts 5% of it as a monthly obligation (assumption A03)

name: salary_account_banks
description: Banks where the applicant holds the salary account
used_by_rules: account_requirement (SBI mandatory; Axis and Kotak lower the income floor); Union SRLGE rate sub-table

name: salary_credited_via_bank
description: Salary is paid into a bank account (cash salary is rejected)
used_by_rules: cash salary rejected for all lenders (HDFC, SBI, Moneyview state it)

name: requested_tenure
description: Tenure the applicant prefers; capped by lender max and age at maturity
used_by_rules: tenure used for EMI and capacity
